package gooo_workspace
namespace gooo_workspace

entity Integer id "urn:gooo:type:integer"
entity Boolean id "urn:gooo:type:boolean"
entity Text id "urn:gooo:type:string"
entity Summary id "urn:learn-gooo:summary" fields {
    field score id "urn:learn-gooo:score" type integer required one
    field remaining id "urn:learn-gooo:remaining" type integer required one
    field in_range id "urn:learn-gooo:in-range-field" type boolean required one
    field label id "urn:learn-gooo:label" type string required one
}
activity GoooPackage0ActivityInRange(Integer) -> Boolean id "urn:learn-gooo:in-range" computes "return input >= 0 && input <= 100"
activity GoooPackage1ActivityClamp(Integer) -> Integer id "urn:learn-gooo:clamp" computes "if input < 0 { return 0 }\nif input > 100 { return 100 }\nreturn input"
activity GoooPackage2ActivityDescribe(Integer, Text) -> Summary id "urn:learn-gooo:describe" computes "let score = GoooPackage1ActivityClamp(input0)\nlet label = input1 + \": low\"\nif score >= 80 { label = input1 + \": high\" }\nreturn Summary{score: score, remaining: 100 - score,\n    in_range: GoooPackage0ActivityInRange(input0), label: label}"

field_observation.scope: required single scalar record fields; reads link latest completed field writes; explicit copy/call-parameter/known record-return parent links and evaluated field read windows; shared RHS, absent helper parents and scalar-local dependencies remain explicit limits; no values retained

local_observation.scope: authored scalar assignments and evaluated uses linked by lexical variable and function invocation; constructor element windows include evaluated helper uses; original use coordinates and complete causal dependencies are not inferred

read_observation.scope: successful scalar collection reads and source-owned constructions; input backing elements and constructed elements have separate identities; element read ranges describe reads during evaluation, not complete scalar data dependencies

input_separation.scope: unique root-input tuples; actual inputs at graph activities and constructed helper calls compared with source output/condition/holdout cases and recorded probes; all supplied expectations across duplicate rows must match; model-training exposure is unknown

runtime.scope: two fresh compiled value-graph executions; finite named expectations; explicit edges and ordered actual values; zero inference during replay/execution
